marvin_bay_unified_school_board_7_truste.name: Marvin Bay Unified school board (7 trustees)

scene.note: events declared visible to this actor are directly experienced

memories.content: The board has the later-start-times proposal on its agenda for both September meetings. Two trustees are up for re-election in November and may be sensitive to public opinion. The proposal has been tabled twice since spring.

The Marlin Bay Unified school board holds two meetings in September 2026. The later-start-times proposal is on the agenda for both meetings. The board can take a recorded vote on the proposal at either meeting. The parent group plans to attend and speak during public comment.
